name: The Sleeve Exchange
prompt: Sew giant sleeves of printed fabric into a chain of soft tunnels across a yard. At each cuff, traders fit new sleeves to old garments. A parade of jackets with delightfully mismatched arms emerges into an open fitting court.

name: The Lost Button Arcade
prompt: Build a little plaza from huge mismatched buttons raised on threadlike columns. Between the buttonholes hang secondhand garments on long cords. Shoppers pull one cord to lower a coat and raise a different one across the square.

name: The Shoe Tide
prompt: Arrange pairs of pre-loved shoes in sweeping pink and brown contour bands around a low cobbler's bench. Customers walk the dry channels between bands, swapping a pair at the edge. One bright pair has just changed the pattern.

name: A Wardrobe by Weight
prompt: Place a giant brass balance over a patchwork carpet. One pan holds folded clothes; the other carries shoppers' trade-ins in coloured bundles. A line of mobile fitting screens on casters winds its way beneath the beam.

name: The Hemline Parliament
prompt: Lay a single circular garment rail around an empty dais. Shoppers stitch discarded skirts edge to edge into a vast communal canopy. One section rises on tall bamboo pins while its unfinished edge still hangs from the rail.
